# infisical_cert_manager_external_ca_microsoft_adcs (Resource)

Create and manage external Microsoft ADCS (Active Directory Certificate Services) certificate authorities in Certificate Manager. Infisical reaches the AD CS server through the Gateway of an `infisical_app_connection_adcs` connection. For the older Azure ADCS web-enrollment CA, use `infisical_cert_manager_external_ca_adcs`. Only Machine Identity authentication is supported for this resource.

## Example Usage

```terraform
terraform {
  required_providers {
    infisical = {
      source = "infisical/infisical"
    }
  }
}

provider "infisical" {
  host          = "https://app.infisical.com"
  client_id     = var.client_id
  client_secret = var.client_secret
}

resource "infisical_app_connection_adcs" "adcs" {
  name   = "adcs-connection"
  method = "username-password"
  credentials = {
    host     = "ca01.corp.example.com"
    username = "CORP\\svc-infisical"
    password = var.adcs_password
  }
  gateway_id = "<gateway-id>"
}

resource "infisical_cert_manager_external_ca_microsoft_adcs" "adcs" {
  name   = "corporate-adcs"
  status = "active"

  app_connection_id = infisical_app_connection_adcs.adcs.id
  ca_name           = "corp-ca01-CA" # Optional, discovered from the CA host over SMB (TCP 445) when omitted
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `app_connection_id` (String) The ID of the `infisical_app_connection_adcs` connection used to reach the AD CS server
- `name` (String) The name of the Microsoft ADCS CA. Must be 1 to 64 lowercase letters, numbers and hyphens.

### Optional

- `ca_name` (String) The AD CS certification authority name, for example `corp-ca01-CA`. Run `certutil -getreg CA\CommonName` on the AD CS server to find it. If omitted, Infisical reads it from the CA host's registry over SMB (TCP 445) when the CA is created and whenever `app_connection_id` changes. Removing a `ca_name` you set keeps the current name. On create, and whenever `ca_name` or `app_connection_id` changes, Infisical checks through the Gateway that it can list certificate templates on the CA, and rejects the change if it cannot.
- `status` (String) The status of the CA. Supported values: active, disabled. Defaults to 'active'.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of the Microsoft ADCS CA

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

```shell
# This will import the external Microsoft ADCS CA by its ID
terraform import infisical_cert_manager_external_ca_microsoft_adcs.example <ca_id>
```
